title: Option to synchronize slideshow wallpapers for multiple screens
line: A random wallpaper slideshow can now show the same image on all screens, changing together, with a new "Show the same image on all screens" option.
explanation: Every screen's desktop runs its own copy of the slideshow, and in Random order each copy shuffled the images with its own random generator, so two screens with identical settings showed different images (the change times were already aligned to the clock). The new option, shown under Order when it is Random, makes each slideshow derive the image from the current time slot: the shuffle for each round is seeded with the round number over the images sorted by path, so every screen with the same images and interval computes the same image. "Next Wallpaper Image" (menu or shortcut) then advances all synchronized screens together.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: Add option to sync random slideshows across screens

Each screen shuffled its random slideshow on its own, so screens showed
different images even with the same settings. The new option picks the
image from the current time slot, so screens using it change together.

BUG: 482542

media.caption: Two screens, same slideshow folder, Random, 10 s: three moments 10 s apart, the screens show different images each time
With the new option on: three moments 10 s apart, both screens always show the same image
Next Wallpaper Image from the right screen's menu changes both screens to the same new image
The new checkbox under Order (only shown for Random)
